skill.description: Build Next.js 16 applications with current App Router patterns, async route props, proxy.ts guidance, cache component updates, and frontend design references.

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from markdown fences, template literals, example fetch calls, and process.env examples. One contextual concern remains: the skill recommends an unpinned npx-based MCP setup that can run changing third-party code.

remediation.issue: Unpinned MCP server setup through npx @latest
remediation.suggestion: Pin next-devtools-mcp to a reviewed version and require explicit user approval before changing MCP configuration.

content.value_statement: Next.js 16 changed routing, params, proxy files, and caching patterns. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused guidance for correct implementations.
actual_capabilities: Explains async params and searchParams patterns for pages, layouts, route handlers, and metadata.
Shows how proxy.ts replaces middleware.ts in Next.js 16 projects.
Provides examples for Server Components, Client Components, API routes, and Server Actions.
Covers Turbopack, cacheComponents, image prop changes, and parallel route defaults.
Includes frontend design guidance for more distinctive React interfaces.
Documents datetime-local handling with UTC conversion patterns.
limitations: It does not build non-React or backend-only applications.
It does not replace official Next.js documentation for late-breaking releases.
Some examples use placeholder services that must be adapted before production use.
MCP setup guidance should be reviewed before installing third-party tooling.

use_cases.title: Create a New Next.js 16 App
use_cases.description: Generate an App Router project with TypeScript, correct route patterns, and modern frontend structure.

use_cases.title: Upgrade a Next.js 15 Project
use_cases.description: Update async route props, proxy files, Turbopack settings, cache options, and image usage.

use_cases.title: Improve Product UI Quality
use_cases.description: Apply distinctive typography, layout, color, and motion guidance to a Next.js interface.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic App
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a simple Next.js 16 App Router project with TypeScript. Include a home page, layout, and one dynamic route.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Route Props
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Next.js page and update params and searchParams for Next.js 16. Explain each required change briefly.

prompt_templates.title: Add Auth Proxy
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement a Next.js 16 proxy.ts and API route pattern for authenticated dashboard requests using httpOnly cookies.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Next.js 15 project for a Next.js 16 upgrade. Prioritize routing, cache, Turbopack, image, and proxy changes.

output_examples.input: A request to build a dashboard with task detail pages.
output_examples.output: A Next.js 16 structure with async dynamic routes, server data loading, API route guidance, and UI composition notes.

output_examples.input: A project still using middleware.ts and synchronous params.
output_examples.output: A migration plan that renames middleware to proxy, awaits route props, and updates affected handlers and metadata.

output_examples.input: A form using datetime-local values for task deadlines.
output_examples.output: A UTC storage and local display approach that prevents timezone drift between browser, API, and database layers.

best_practices: Check official Next.js release notes when working near version boundaries.
Keep examples adapted to the project architecture before using them in production.
Review third-party MCP and npm commands before running or saving them.
anti_patterns: Using synchronous params or searchParams in Next.js 16 route files.
Creating middleware.ts for new Next.js 16 proxy behavior.
Copying placeholder fetch URLs, tokens, or proxy examples into production unchanged.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build and migrate Next.js 16 applications using current App Router and frontend patterns.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Can it upgrade a Next.js 15 project?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers async route props, proxy.ts, Turbopack, cacheComponents, image changes, and parallel route defaults.

faq.question: Does it include UI design guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes typography, color, layout, motion, and visual direction guidance for React interfaces.

faq.question: Does it run network requests by itself?
faq.answer: No. Network calls appear as application examples, not as skill execution behavior.

faq.question: Should MCP setup commands be reviewed?
faq.answer: Yes. Review and pin third-party MCP packages before adding them to a local configuration.
